items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK, Beispielweg 1, 34117 Neu-Musterdorf, zu erheben.
items.computation: Anchor: the letter is dated (posted) Thu 12.03.2026. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter sent by ordinary domestic post counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) on Mon 16.03.2026 (the applicable postal-notice rule for this posting date; no weekend shift needed since it falls on a weekday). Counting of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), i.e. from 16.03.2026, and one month later ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Thu 16.04.2026. That day is an ordinary business day, so no further Saturday/Sunday/holiday shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). Note: the letter is internally inconsistent — dated 12.03.2026 but referring in its own text to 'mit Bescheid vom 16.03.2026', a date after the letter's own date, which is logically impossible for a decision already communicated; the earlier printed letter date (12.03.2026) was used as the safer, earliest-plausible anchor so as not to overstate the time available.

warnings: The letter is dated 12.03.2026 but its body refers to 'mit Bescheid vom 16.03.2026' — a decision date after the letter's own date, which is internally contradictory; the earlier date was used to compute the deadline conservatively, but the actual delivery date of the real Bescheid should be checked against the envelope postmark or the actual decision document.

The letter rejects the Haushaltshilfe application on the stated ground that no child under 12 lives in the household and the statute provides no broader benefit; if this is factually wrong (e.g., a qualifying child or another statutory ground applies), that should be raised in the Widerspruch.
